matching_config.metric_definition: Standardized Mahalanobis-like Euclidean Distance over 6 pre-group structural covariates

approved_scientific_interpretation: Under the evaluated state-matched protocol, we did not observe evidence of a recovery-specific advantage for the Instruct checkpoint over the Base checkpoint. The estimated matched recovery-specific checkpoint-interface contrast was -0.110, with a 95% descriptive problem-level bootstrap interval of [-0.240, 0.030].
approved_empirical_statement: recovery_eval was applied to 400 genuine neural continuations from two released Qwen2.5-Math 1.5B checkpoint-interface configurations using prospectively frozen recovery/control pairs and end-to-end primitive provenance.
